$schema-note: Coverage of meridian.ui.v1.PanelDescriptor's `body` oneof, per renderer. Checked against proto/panel.proto by tools/check_coverage.mjs: the arm set must match exactly, every non-'renders' cell must carry a reason, and a full-parity arm that is missing or structurally unrenderable must carry a waiver. Adding an arm to the proto without declaring its coverage fails.

statuses.placeholder: The renderer draws an explanatory placeholder instead of the shape.
statuses.separate-entrypoint: Drawn, but by a dedicated entrypoint outside the main dispatch.
statuses.structural-gap: Cannot be implemented without an API change — no seam exists.
statuses.not-applicable: This tier does not own the shape.

parity.full: panel.proto: every modality realizes it at full fidelity.
parity.specialized: panel.proto: cannot meet the parity bar; documents a degradation ladder.
parity.standard: A fetch/interactive shape with no explicit parity declaration.
